Des disques de cuivre et de zinc séparés: Copper and zinc discs separated by cardboard soaked in salt water: the first source of direct current.
La pile de Volta. Cuivre, zinc, carton s: Volta's pile. Copper, zinc, salted cardboard. I'm plugging you in: two squares of direct current.
Volta décrit à Banks un « organe électri: Volta describes to Banks an “artificial electric organ” made of stacked metal discs, which gives a continuous current without needing to be recharged.
Le premier condensateur. L'abbé Nollet f: The first capacitor. Abbé Nollet sent its discharge through a chain of 180 royal guards, who all jumped at once.
Une bouteille de Leyde. L'abbé Nollet a: A Leyden jar. Abbé Nollet made 180 royal guards jump with it. Your pawn jumps too: two squares back.
Je ne voudrais pas recevoir un second co: I would not take a second shock like that for the kingdom of France.
Un filament de carbone qui tient des cen: A carbon filament that lasts hundreds of hours. Edison's real invention was the grid that powers it.
L'ampoule d'Edison. J'ai une idée : une: Edison's light bulb. I have an idea: one square for you. The power grid, you're paying for it.
Selon le New York Herald, Edison annonce: According to the New York Herald, Edison announced that with electric light, only the extravagant would still burn tallow candles.
Un anneau de fer entouré de deux bobines: An iron ring wrapped in two coils. When Faraday connects one, a current flows for an instant in the other: induction is discovered.
L'anneau de Faraday : le courant ne pass: Faraday's ring: the current only flows for an instant in the other coil. Your pawn only moves for an instant: one square.
Faraday note qu'au moment où il ferme le: Faraday notes that the moment he closes the circuit of the first coil, the needle of the galvanometer connected to the second swings, then returns to zero.
Un cerf-volant, une clé, un orage. L'exp: A kite, a key, a thunderstorm. The experiment is mainly known through Priestley's account, fifteen years later, and imitating it cost Georg Richmann his life in 1753.
Le cerf-volant de Franklin, par temps d': Franklin's kite, in a thunderstorm. Richmann died of it in 1753. For me, it mostly attracts an enemy, which I'm placing on your path.
Priestley rapporte que Franklin attendit: Priestley reports that Franklin waited for the storm, saw the fibers of the string bristle, and drew a spark from the key by bringing his hand close.
À Colorado Springs, en 1899, Tesla produ: In Colorado Springs, in 1899, Tesla produces artificial lightning bolts tens of meters long. According to his biographers, one of his experiments blew out the power company's dynamo and plunged the town into darkness.
Des éclairs ! Du bruit ! Des étincelles: Lightning! Noise! Sparks everywhere! Now that's a gift. Your pawn is electrified: three squares. The Colorado Springs power plant liked it less.
Des éclairs artificiels de plus de trent: Artificial lightning over thirty meters long shoots from the mast of his Colorado Springs station.
